title: A change to a check survives a restart, and a refused one changes no file
when: On a copy of the Tool Library's data, runs one of the Check aggregate's own commands, then the same command refused, then closes the store and opens it again on the same files.
then: Expects the refused command to leave every data file byte for byte as it was, and the change read back after the restart.

title: A crash between two files of one change to a check leaves the data as it was or as the change meant
when: On a copy of the Tool Library's data, runs the aggregate's own commands as one write, stopped as a crash would stop it: while a new data file is half written, while the journal is half written, and right after the first data file is renamed into place; opens the store again after each.
then: Expects the data as it was after the first two stops (the load rolls the write back) and as the change meant after the third (the load finishes it from the journal), never a mix of the two.

title: lathe check on Lathe's own spec takes under 20 s
when: `npm --prefix lathe run test:perf`. Runs `lathe check` in a fresh process on a copy of Lathe's own data (about 7,000 records) and times it from start to exit.
then: Expects the run under 20 s. On a busy machine (a one-minute load average above 12) it judges nothing and exits 3.
notes: Runs only in the performance batch, never in scripts/ci.sh.

title: The chosen space reads back from local storage and its last page from session storage
when: Saves a chosen space and its last page through the repository, reads them through a new one, then clears session storage.
then: Expects the chosen space kept and the last page gone with the session.

title: A domain unfolded in the nav is saved in session storage, never in local storage
when: Opens the product page and unfolds a domain in the nav.
then: Expects the unfolded row saved under lathe:nav-folders in session storage, and nothing under it in local storage.

title: The tabs saved in session storage open again with the window, and none is written to local storage
when: In the desktop app, with two tabs saved in session storage, opens the app.
then: Expects both tabs open again, and nothing under lathe:tabs in local storage.

title: The settings saved read back from session storage, and none is written to local storage
when: Saves the graph's layout and minimap through the Session settings' repository, then loads them through a new one.
then: Expects them read back from session storage, and nothing under their key in local storage.

title: The index updated by what changed equals the index built afresh
when: Applies random sets of edited, added, removed, moved and relinked records to a space's summaries, one after another.
then: Expects after each set the records, children, links and domains from the last answer to be, in order, those built from the answer alone.
notes: Runs the app's record index over the record summaries' answers as they come, the lowest level a storage requirement test allows.

title: An unchanged record stays the same object, and an unchanged answer the same records
when: Reads an answer again unchanged, then with one record retitled.
then: Expects the same records when nothing changed, and when one did, every other record and the links' lookups the same objects as before.
notes: Runs the app's record index over the record summaries' answers as they come, the lowest level a storage requirement test allows.

title: The folder tree is looked up again only when the tree or the records changed
when: Builds two indexes that differ only in their problems, then one with a record retitled.
then: Expects the two to share the looked-up folders, and the retitled one not to.
notes: Runs the app's record index over the record summaries' answers as they come, the lowest level a storage requirement test allows.

title: A config saved reads back whole, a repo without one reads none, and a broken one is refused
when: Saves a config through the repository in a temporary repo, reads it through a new one, then reads a repo with none and one with a broken file.
then: Expects the config back whole, none for the repo without one, and a refusal naming the broken file.

title: Settings saved read back after a relaunch, a hand edit is read on the next load, and a broken file gives the defaults
when: Saves the settings through the repository, reads them through a new one, edits the file by hand, then breaks it.
then: Expects the saved settings, then the hand edit, then the defaults.

title: The bindings saved read back from local storage, and a blocked storage loses only the bindings
when: Saves a changed and an unbound shortcut through the Key bindings' repository, loads them through a new one, then blocks local storage and saves again.
then: Expects `{ toggleNav: ["Ctrl+J"], goHome: null }` stored and read back, and the save on blocked storage not to throw, leaving the defaults.

title: The voice settings saved read back from local storage, and a malformed or blocked storage gives the defaults
when: Saves the voice settings through their repository, reads them through a new one, then malforms and blocks local storage.
then: Expects the saved settings from local storage and none in session storage, then the defaults.

title: A folder's chat mode is kept by folder, the default left out, and read back by a new repository
when: Chooses a folder's chat mode, reads the modes through a new repository, then chooses the default again.
then: Expects the mode kept by folder and read back, and the default left out of the file.

title: A panel's width reads back from local storage, and the app works on when storage refuses
when: Saves the nav's width and collapsed state through the Panel's repository, loads them through a new one, then blocks local storage and saves and loads again.
then: Expects the width read back from local storage and none in session storage, and with storage blocked no error and the default width.

title: The themes and choices saved read back from local storage, and a blocked storage loses only the choice
when: Saves the color mode and Scroll to zoom through the Appearance's repository, loads them through a new one, then blocks local storage and saves again.
then: Expects Scroll to zoom off at first, both choices read back from local storage, and no error when storage is blocked.

title: A saved window reopens at its place after a relaunch, and a broken file is a fresh start
when: Saves a window's place through the Product window's repository into a fresh user data folder, loads it through a new repository as the next launch does, then breaks the file and loads again.
then: Expects the window at its saved place, and a broken file read as no saved places.

title: After a quit and a relaunch, each window starts or finds its server again
manual_reason: It needs the packaged desktop app quit and launched again, with its windows on a real display.
when: Opens two product windows in the packaged app, quits it, and launches it again.
then: Expects both windows back at their places, each with a server of its own, and no server of the last run still answering.

title: A folder's server keeps the port it got, starts there on the next launch, and takes a free one when it is taken
when: Starts a folder's server, starts it again through a new repository on the same ports file, starts the shared dev server for another folder, reads a ports file with unusable ports, then starts a server on a free port twice.
then: Expects the port kept in the file and asked for on the next start, neither 5199 nor an unusable port kept, the first server on the port asked for and the second on another.

title: The recent list, latest first, reads back after a relaunch, and no half-written file is left
when: Saves two folders through the Recent folders' repository into a fresh user data folder, loads them through a new repository, and loads a file that is not there.
then: Expects the two folders latest first, no temporary file left behind, and an empty list for the missing file.

title: A crash between two files of one change to a use case leaves the data as it was or as the change meant
when: On a copy of the Tool Library's data, runs the aggregate's own commands as one write, stopped as a crash would stop it: while a new data file is half written, while the journal is half written, and right after the first data file is renamed into place; opens the store again after each.
then: Expects the data as it was after the first two stops (the load rolls the write back) and as the change meant after the third (the load finishes it from the journal), never a mix of the two.
